fields.label: Server name (MOTD)
fields.help: The line shown under your server in the multiplayer list.

fields.label: Hardcore
fields.help: Players are banned when they die.

fields.label: Player vs player
fields.help: Players can hurt each other.

fields.label: Whitelist
fields.help: Only players on the whitelist can join.

fields.label: Kick non-whitelisted players
fields.help: When the whitelist changes, kick anyone no longer on it.

fields.label: Check accounts with Mojang
fields.help: Leave this ON. Turning it off lets anyone join with any name.

fields.label: World folder name
fields.help: Changing this makes a brand new world (the old one stays in its folder).

fields.label: World seed
fields.help: Only used when a new world is created.

fields.label: World type
fields.help: Only used when a new world is created.

fields.label: Generate structures
fields.help: Villages, temples, etc. in new chunks.

fields.label: Spawn protection radius
fields.help: Blocks around spawn that only ops can edit. 0 turns it off.

fields.label: Allow flying
fields.help: Turn ON for modded servers, otherwise players get kicked for 'flying' with jetpacks, elytra tricks, etc.

fields.label: Force default game mode on join
View distance (chunks)
fields.help: Lower this first if the server lags with several players.

fields.label: Simulation distance (chunks)
fields.help: How far from players mobs and machines actually run.

fields.label: Watchdog timeout (ms)
fields.help: Set to -1 to stop 'server stopped responding' crashes while a big modpack is busy.

fields.label: Network compression threshold
fields.help: -1 turns compression off (fine on a home network).

fields.label: Sync chunk writes
fields.help: Safer against corruption, a little slower.

fields.label: Kick idle players after (minutes)
fields.help: 0 = never.

fields.label: Server port
fields.help: Friends use this in the address. If you change it, update any port forward.

fields.label: Bind to IP
fields.help: Leave empty unless you know you need it.

fields.label: Hide player list in server list
Op permission level
fields.help: 4 = full control.
